summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Peta-Kaye Croft, an Australian Labor Party politician born in Mount Isa in 1972. It states she represented the Queensland Legislative Assembly seat of Broadwater after winning it at the 2001 election, and that she lost the seat at the 2012 election to Verity Barton.
one_line: Peta-Kaye Croft is a former Australian Labor Party member for Broadwater in the Queensland Legislative Assembly, serving from 2001 to 2012.
key_facts: Peta-Kaye Croft was born on 5 August 1972 in Mount Isa.
Peta-Kaye Croft is an Australian Labor Party politician.
Peta-Kaye Croft represented the seat of Broadwater in the Legislative Assembly of Queensland.
Peta-Kaye Croft entered Parliament at the 2001 election.
At the 2001 election, Peta-Kaye Croft defeated Allan Grice.
Peta-Kaye Croft was defeated at the 2012 election.
Verity Barton defeated Peta-Kaye Croft at the 2012 election.
The Broadwater seat was held by Peta-Kaye Croft from 2001 until 2012 according to the note's entry dates.
